program.ge_pattern: Columbia College General Education (CC-GE) Pattern or California General Education Transfer Curriculum (Cal-GETC) Pattern
outcomes: Demonstrate knowledge and skills in compliance with state fire training requirements for applicable certifications.
Demonstrate the necessary knowledge and skills as an Emergency Medical Technician (EMT) according to industry standards.
Examine and identify real-world examples of concepts explored in coursework and their implication for fire science.
Describe procedures in compliance with laws, regulations, codes, and standards that influence fire department operations.

notes: Codes are printed without a space (e.g. 'EMS4', 'FIRE29A'); they match the closed-list codes 'EMS 4', 'FIRE 29A', etc.
Degree total of 60 taken from the page header '28.5 - 29.5 Major Units | 60 Total Units Required'.
Two GE patterns are offered (CC-GE or Cal-GETC); no GE unit total is printed.
Electives note: 'Credit may be earned for FIRE97 or EMS97 but not for both.' A stray '2 - 4 units' line follows this note; its meaning is unclear.
'Required Courses: Choose One' is recorded as choose_units 3.5, which is equivalent to choosing one of the two 3.5-unit courses.

The description section has the lead-in 'Upon satisfactory completion of this award, the student should be prepared to:' with nothing printed under it. The outcomes were taken from the Program Learning Outcomes section.
The second outcome had a line break ('industry / standards'), which was read as a space.
